LLM Fine-Tuning & Model Operations exists because the hard part of this work is not the model — it is the measurement, the ownership and the audit trail. That is what this page describes.

blocks.title: Grounded generation fabric — LLM Fine-Tuning & Model Operations
blocks.note: Signals, context and policy converge at the decision layer; every scored decision is logged with its inputs so it can be replayed at audit.

blocks.x: Every component in LLM Fine-Tuning & Model Operations has a contract, a version and a named owner. When something drifts, the ticket goes to a person, not to a committee — that is what the reference architecture is for.

The build sequence is deliberate: contracts and identity first, the working decision slice second, the verification harness third — because a LLM Fine-Tuning & Model Operations capability without its eval gate is just another unattended automation.

items: Ungrounded fluency
Answers require retrievable evidence — fluency without grounding fails the eval and stays off the menu.

Personal data fenced at the boundary with redaction before any model or analyst sees it.
